testcase.name: an entry is named by the report header's date form
the chip counts the shown entries, singular for one
each halo source receives the highlighted records of its kind, each feature carrying its record's id
up to three keeping entries are each a date line labelled Open entry and the date
a highlighted record's bubble carries the entries that keep it, for each of the five kinds, and no other record's does
more than three keeping entries are one line, Kept in N journal entries, over a list of their dates
the Journal entries switch hides every halo together, and shows them all by default
the Maps tab's Layers sheet lists Journal entries last, and the entry map's does not
a stored Journal entries off is restored like the other overlay switches
each line halo is the halo width wider on each side than what it lies under, and thins with the zoom as the track does
a record switched off takes its own halo with it and no other
